slices.title: preserve-station-baseline
slices.summary: Frozen station ownership, geometry, DOM and screenshot anchors, performance pressure, and rollback boundary; 73 tutorial tests, 17 CSS tests, canonical Chromium visual check, and workspace validation pass without choreography changes.

slices.title: pure-station-phase-model
slices.summary: Added a pure economics-local station phase projector for approach, ready, scrub, settle, and handoff with explicit ownership, checkpoint, and semantic progress; ordinary cues skip motion. Monotonic, direct, reverse, invalid-geometry, typecheck, and 77 tutorial checks pass. No DOM or paint integration.

slices.title: local-station-geometry
slices.summary: Station geometry now derives from one usable viewport with persistent/safe-area insets; graph latch and rail entrance share one projection, and rails remain absent until the graph latches. Unit, CSS, Chromium visual, and type checks pass.

slices.title: cue-approach-projection
slices.summary: Cue materialization now begins when the paragraph bottom enters the station rails, reaches stable ink and scale at ready, and uses no blur or card chrome. Existing exit remains reversible; full tutorial, CSS, Chromium visual, and type checks pass.

slices.title: ordinary-cue-rhythm
slices.summary: Ordinary cues now expose a tokenized 10vh reading hold and deterministic settle/handoff projection independent of paragraph height; semantic progress remains zero. Short/long cue, direct seek, reverse, resize, CSS, type, and full tutorial checks pass.
